hooks.command: echo 'my_architect: a task was just closed. Run the Workflow A scan-for-gaps pass NOW: re-read the commit body AND the current chat turn, flag every "deferred / caveat / known issue / not yet wired / to be tested when / could improve later / out of scope / manual probes pending" item, and dispatch the debt-scanner for each (Workflow B). Then give the end-of-turn summary: for each flagged item state either "already tracked in <node-id>" or "new node <node-id> created under epic <epic-id>".'
